title: Avo school final(90Q)
description: 90-question AVO school final covering avionics, electrical, electronic, flight instrument, navigation, communication, and aircraft systems topics.

questions.question: Stab trim actuator moves the ______.
questions.explanation: The source marks Horizontal stabilizer as the answer.

questions.question: Where do you see the pitch limit indicator (PLI)?
questions.explanation: The source marks EADI as the answer.

questions.question: Field Loadable Software (FLS) is distributed by:
options: A. By electronic transfer, CD-ROM or PCMCIA
B. By Personal Computer Memory Card International (PCMCIA) only
questions.explanation: The source marks electronic transfer, CD-ROM or PCMCIA as the answer.

questions.question: Glideslope annunciation shows ____ color when GS beam is captured.
questions.explanation: The source marks Green as the answer.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is wrong about aircraft software restriction?
options: A. Modifications to aircraft software will be subject to the same approval procedures as are applied to hardware modifications.
B. Modifications to aircraft software may not be subjected to the same approval procedures as are applied to hardware modifications.
C. Post-certificate modification of software of equipment in the catastrophic, hazardous, or major categories must not be made unless it has been approved by the responsible design organization.
questions.explanation: The source marks the second statement as the answer.

questions.question: Which of the following is not true about software certification?
options: A. Post-certification modification must be based on rule apply to the application on hardware.
B. Initial certification of software must be designed from approved company.
C. Post-certification modification must not be based on rule apply to the application on hardware.
questions.explanation: The source marks the third statement as the answer.

questions.question: The capacity of a single battery cell in a series-connected battery is:
options: C. Less than the battery capacity
questions.explanation: In the source, Equal with battery capacity is marked.

questions.question: Three essential elements of an oscillator circuit are ______.
options: A. An amplifier, a wave shaping network and negative feedback
B. An amplifier, a positive feedback path and a wave shaping network
C. An AC input, a wave shaping network and an amplifier
questions.explanation: The source marks the amplifier, positive feedback path and wave shaping network combination.

questions.question: In an NPN transistor the P is the:
questions.explanation: The source marks Base as the answer.

questions.question: The smallest particles of an element or a compound which can normally separately exist is called ______.
questions.explanation: The source marks Atoms as the answer.

questions.question: What is the primary function of the microcontroller bus and timing system?
options: A. It facilitates communication between different components within the microcontroller chip.
B. It regulates power distribution to various parts of the microcontroller.
C. It monitors external input/output devices connected to the microcontroller.
questions.explanation: The source marks the communication function as the answer.

questions.question: Skin effect occurs when a conductor carries current at ______ frequencies.
questions.explanation: The source marks High as the answer.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT the major function of a transformer in a power supply circuit?
options: A. Alternating AC waveform to DC waveform
B. Electrical isolation of load from main power line
C. Step up/down AC voltages and currents
questions.explanation: The source marks Alternating AC waveform to DC waveform.

questions.question: The international system of units (SI) of power is ______.
questions.explanation: The source marks Watt as the answer.

questions.question: In a binary weighted resistor, if each digital HIGH bit represents 5 V, what will be the analog voltage for the digital bit 1001?
questions.explanation: The source marks 5.625 V as the answer.

questions.question: Class AB operation is often used in power amplifiers in order to:
questions.explanation: The source marks overcoming crossover distortion.

questions.question: What does a buffer primarily do to a digital signal?
questions.explanation: The source marks Provide extra current drive.

questions.question: What is the purpose of interface chips in a microcontroller?
options: A. Correct error sent by the I/O devices
B. Interface the RAM and ROM
C. Convert signals between microprocessor and peripherals.
questions.explanation: The source marks converting signals between the microprocessor and peripherals.

questions.question: When the temperature increases, the resistance of pure metals will ______.
questions.explanation: The source marks Increase as the answer.

questions.question: Inductance affects the direct current flow:
options: A. Only at the time of turning off
B. At the time of turning on and off
C. At all the time of operation
questions.explanation: The source marks At the time of turning on and off.

questions.question: What type of feedback is required to sustain the oscillation of an oscillator circuit?
questions.explanation: The source marks Positive or regenerative feedback.

questions.question: _____ filters allow all frequencies above a certain cut-off frequency to pass.
questions.explanation: The source marks High Pass.

questions.question: A system that converts a digital signal into an analog signal is called:
questions.explanation: The source marks DAC.

questions.question: In Boolean algebra AND law, which of the following is true?
questions.explanation: The source marks A·A=A.

questions.question: The grounding lead resistance must not be less than ______ ohm to prevent shock hazard in case of inadvertent contact with higher voltages.
questions.explanation: The source marks 1k as the answer.

questions.question: What is the abbreviation of AWG?
questions.explanation: The source marks American Wire Gauge.

questions.question: What does EHSI stand for?
questions.explanation: The source marks Electronic Horizontal Situation Indicator (EHSI).

questions.question: Before wire can be assembled to connectors, terminals, splices, etc., the insulation must be ______ from connecting ends to expose the bare conductor.
questions.explanation: The source marks Stripped.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of capacitance?
questions.explanation: The source marks Farad (F).

questions.question: The period of a wave is:
options: A. The same as the frequency
B. Time required to complete one cycle
questions.explanation: The source marks Time required to complete one cycle.

questions.question: _____ is the process of electrically connecting the various metallic parts of an aircraft so that they will collectively form an integral electronic unit.
questions.explanation: The source marks Bonding.

questions.question: How are voltage multipliers constructed?
options: A. By different combinations of inductors
B. By different combinations of capacitors and inductors
C. By different combinations of diodes and capacitors
questions.explanation: The source marks combinations of diodes and capacitors.

questions.question: Airplanes with multiple independent pitot and static systems require:
options: A. All systems checked for leaks
B. Random systems checked for leaks
C. No leak check is required for such type
questions.explanation: The source marks all systems checked for leaks.

questions.question: Which one of the following mechanisms is used to control drift on the gyro head for remote indication systems?
options: A. Torque leveling system with level switches
B. Slaving torque motors with amplifiers
C. Only a liquid leveling switch
questions.explanation: The source marks slaving torque motors with amplifiers.

questions.question: Which one of the following is not a requirement for a rotating wheel to be a gyro?
questions.explanation: The source marks Fixed spin axis.

questions.question: Which of the following gyro rotors is canted upward 30 degrees?
options: B. Rate gyros for rate of turn indicator
questions.explanation: The source marks rate gyros for the rate-of-turn indicator.

questions.question: Which one of the following is true about the error signal that is computed in an autopilot?
options: A. Both A and B are true
B. Provide command to the autopilot servo
C. Become zero (null) when equivalent feedback signal is sent to autopilot computer
questions.explanation: The source marks Both A and B are true.

questions.question: Which of the following is not correct about ring laser gyros?
options: A. They measure movement about an axis extremely quickly and provide continuous output
B. They are very rugged and have a shorter service life.
C. They are extremely accurate and generally are considered superior to mechanical gyroscopes.
questions.explanation: The source marks the second statement.

questions.question: The procedure of correcting deviation error in a magnetic compass indication is called:
questions.explanation: The source marks Compass Swinging.

questions.question: Which one of the following is not correct about a compass bowl?
options: A. It can be made from plastic
B. A brass case forms the bowl
C. It can be made from magnetic material
questions.explanation: The source marks It can be made from plastic.

questions.question: What indication will an instantaneous vertical speed indicator present when the aircraft is moving downwards with its pitch down?
questions.explanation: The source marks Rate of descent.

questions.question: What parameter of an antenna is the ratio of the effective radiating area to the physical area of the antenna?
questions.explanation: The source marks Aperture efficiency.

questions.question: How does an aircraft become electrically charged as it flies through the air?
options: A. An aircraft cannot be charged when it flies through the air.
B. There is friction between the aircraft and air which causes electron transfer between the aircraft and air.
C. The aircraft fuselage material determines whether it is charged or not.
questions.explanation: The source marks friction and electron transfer as the answer.

questions.question: A device that moves a primary control surface in response to an autopilot output is known as:
questions.explanation: The source marks Servo.

questions.question: Which of the following is a horizontal directional locator?
questions.explanation: The source marks Locator.

questions.question: In an ADF control panel, when REC is selected:
options: A. The radio output is only bearing information
B. The radio uses a conventional AM receiver
C. The radio uses only the ADF loop antenna
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; the first option is retained for this JSON.

questions.question: What is the progressive decrease of signal strength with increasing distance called?
questions.explanation: Attenuation describes progressive signal-strength loss with distance.

questions.question: Which one of the following types of synchros is DC operated?
questions.explanation: The source marks Basic design.

questions.question: The green color on the Weather Radar display indicates:
questions.explanation: The source marks Light concentration, slight turbulence.

questions.question: Which of the following is the semiconductor diode which can be used in switching microwave signals?
questions.explanation: PIN diodes are used as RF/microwave switches; the source page does not show a visible selected answer.

questions.question: How much voltage do typical zener diodes produce at their operating point?
questions.explanation: The source marks 10 to 100 mV.

questions.question: Where is the VHF antenna located?
options: C. Top and bottom of the fuselage
questions.explanation: The source marks On the vertical stabilizer.

questions.question: What is the receiver part of a synchro system?
questions.explanation: A synchro receiver is represented by the motor element.

questions.question: In an optical fiber, the concept of numerical aperture is applicable in determining the ability of:
questions.explanation: Numerical aperture relates to the light-gathering ability of an optical fiber.

questions.question: Which frequency band is not used for satellite transmission?
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; L-band is retained here.

questions.question: On BITE, ______ supplies trend and servicing information and monitoring reports for the detection of possible failure appearance.
questions.explanation: The source wording identifies Maintenance Support as the selected choice.

questions.question: How many inputs are there to the recording heads of the GMR system?
questions.explanation: The source marks Four.

questions.question: Which one of the following communication systems is used by the cockpit crew, cabin crew and maintenance crew?
questions.explanation: The source marks Service Interphone System.

questions.question: The differing properties of land and water with regard to electromagnetic ground wave absorption cause ______ of NDB transmission.
questions.explanation: The source marks Coastal refraction.

questions.question: Which one of the following grouping of instruments can be considered as flight instruments?
options: A. Oil temperature indication, tachometer, cylinder head temperature indications
B. Weather indication, ground collision alerting, anti-collision indications
C. Airspeed, altimeter, altitude, vertical speed, rate of turn and bank indications
questions.explanation: The source marks the airspeed, altimeter, altitude, vertical speed, rate-of-turn and bank group.

questions.question: VOR navigation aids are identified by how many alpha characters?
questions.explanation: The source marks Three.

questions.question: The number of independent PSUs in a typical commercial aircraft is:
questions.explanation: The source marks 2.

questions.question: Which of the following is true about the synchronous motor?
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; Not a self-starting motor is retained.

questions.question: What affects the frequency of the alternator?
questions.explanation: The source marks Number of poles.

questions.question: Which of the following power-consuming devices is always supplied from the battery bus?
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; Vital D.C. consumers is retained.

questions.question: What section represents the type of information contained within the 32-bit word of ARINC 429 specification?
questions.explanation: The Label field identifies the type of information in an ARINC 429 word.

questions.question: Failure of the differential current relay would be backed up by:
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; Exciter protection relay is retained.

questions.question: Which of the following power-consuming devices is always supplied from the battery bus?
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; Vital D.C. consumers is retained.

questions.question: In an aircraft brushless AC generator, the pilot exciter armature is mounted:
options: A. On the main generator stator
B. On the exciter generator stator
C. On the exciter generator rotor
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; On the exciter generator rotor is retained.

questions.question: The modern AC alternator does not utilize brushes or slip rings, known as:
questions.explanation: The source marks Brushless.

questions.question: What do protocols (set of rules) govern?
questions.explanation: Protocols govern communication between systems or devices.

questions.question: The RVDT consists of:
options: A. One primary winding and two secondary windings
B. One primary winding and one secondary winding
C. Two primary windings and one secondary winding
questions.explanation: An RVDT uses one primary and two secondary windings.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a common type of position sensor?
options: A. Linear Rotary Variable Differential Transformer (LRVDT)
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; LRVDT is retained.

questions.question: What is the loss in signal power called as the signal travels down the line?
questions.explanation: The source wording corresponds to attenuation.

questions.question: What term applies to the difference between the speed of the rotating stator field and the rotor?
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; Slip is retained.

questions.question: Which of the following is true about the synchronous motor?
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; Not a self-starting motor is retained.

questions.question: What affects the frequency of the alternator?
questions.explanation: The source marks Number of poles.

questions.question: Some actuator motors are subjected to heavy and sudden loads. Because of this such motors are equipped with:
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; Overload release clutch is retained.

questions.question: Which of the following is true about servo motors?
options: A. The servo motor utilizes a regular motor and couples it with a sensor for positional feedback.
B. The output shaft of this motor can be moved to a particular angle, position and velocity that a regular motor does not have.
C. A servo motor rotates only in one direction.
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; the first statement is retained.

questions.question: Both engines are normally pressure fed from the center tank:
options: A. Alternatively from both center & main tanks
B. Always from center tank, quantity decreases to near zero
C. Until the center tank quantity decreases to near zero
questions.explanation: The source marks Alternatively from both center & main tanks.

questions.question: Failure of the differential current relay would be backed up by:
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; Exciter protection relay is retained.

questions.question: Which of the following is a component of the motor, has dual function, and supports the rotating parts of the machine?
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; Outer Frame is retained.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a factor that affects the resistance of a conductor?
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; Surface area is retained.

questions.question: What is the relationship between current and voltage in a pure resistor circuit?
options: A. Current lags behind the voltage by 90 degrees
B. Current leads the voltage by 90 degrees
C. Current is in phase with the voltage
questions.explanation: The source visibly marks the first option, so that answer is preserved exactly as requested.

questions.question: A monotonic DAC is one whose analog output increases for:
options: A. An increase in digital output
B. An increase in analog input
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; the first option is retained.

questions.question: The type of register in which data is entered into it only one bit at a time, but a single clock pulse can make it available as output terminals is:
questions.explanation: This description corresponds to a serial-in parallel-out register.

questions.question: Which terminal belongs to the SCR?
questions.explanation: The source marks Anode.

questions.question: For which part of the wing does the wing thermal anti-ice system prevent ice?
options: A. The trailing edge of the wing
B. The upper surface of the wing
C. The leading edges of the wing
questions.explanation: The source marks The leading edges of the wing.

questions.question: Which of the following is the term given for the effect of armature flux on the main field flux?
questions.explanation: The source page does not visibly mark an answer; Armature reaction is retained.

questions.question: The first commercial aircraft was the:
questions.explanation: The source visibly marks Boeing 707.
